description: This file provides utility functions for managing popover collision detection and positioning logic, including handling overflows, collision checks, and alignment adjustments based on popover and container rectangles.

methods.name: OppositeSide
methods.description: Mapping of each popover side to its opposite side.

methods.name: getOverflows
methods.description: Calculates the overflow distances of the popover rect relative to the document rect on each side.

methods.name: checkCollisions
methods.description: Checks whether the popover rect collides with container boundaries, returning a RectCollisions object.

methods.name: getNonCollidingSide
methods.description: Determines which side to prefer when positioning, considering collision states.

methods.name: OppositeAlignment
methods.description: Mapping for aligning start/end options to their opposites.

methods.name: getNonCollidingAlignment
methods.description: Decides the best alignment ('start', 'end', 'center') for the popover based on collision information and preferences.

ctags.name: checkCollisions
ctags.pattern: /^export const checkCollisions = (popoverRect: DOMRect, containerRect: DOMRect): RectCollisions =>/

ctags.name: const
ctags.pattern: /^export const getOverflows = (popoverRect: DOMRect, documentRect: DOMRect): Record<PopoverSide, n/

ctags.name: export
ctags.pattern: /^export const getOverflows = (popoverRect: DOMRect, documentRect: DOMRect): Record<PopoverSide, n/

ctags.name: getOverflows
ctags.pattern: /^export const getOverflows = (popoverRect: DOMRect, documentRect: DOMRect): Record<PopoverSide, n/
